subject.title: Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District — Measure G (Fire Safety, Job Training, College Affordability, No Tax Rate Increase Measure)

positions.statement: Jim Mahler (President, American Federation of Teachers Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District) signed the argument in favor of Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Measure G in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
